description: RALEIGH, N.C. — Senator Michael Lazzara (R-Onslow) has been appointed by Senate Leader Phil Berger to serve on several key legislative oversight committees for the 2025-26 interim period, as follows: ● Co-Chair of the Joint Legislative Oversight Committee on Unemployment Insurance● Member of the Joint Legislative Oversight Committee on Capital Improvements● Member of the Joint Legislative Oversight Committee on Justice and Public Safety● Member of the Joint Legislative Oversight
title: NEWS: Lazzara appointed to key legislative interim committees
